name: Westfield Topanga
description: Westfield Topanga is a premier luxury shopping destination in the San Fernando Valley featuring high-end fashion brands including Balenciaga, Bottega Veneta, Prada, Saint Laurent, and Cartier. This upscale regional mall offers an exceptional mix of designer boutiques, contemporary retailers, gourmet dining options including STK Steakhouse and JINYA Ramen Bar, entertainment venues with AMC Theatres, and modern amenities including 27 electric vehicle charging stations.
summary: An upscale regional mall in Canoga Park featuring luxury fashion brands, fine dining, entertainment, and premium amenities in the San Fernando Valley.
